name: boundlessinfo-steam-bot
description: Steam-login discovery bot for Boundless Info. Authenticates with the owner's own Steam + Boundless player account (no blessed API key), discovers live exoworlds + their world poll resources by probing world IDs against the universe discovery server, and POSTs the results to the Boundless Info ingest API. Faithfully ported from the MIT-licensed Boundlexx (Angellus) game client.
//devDependencies: Dev-time only, and PINNED rather than caret-ranged on purpose: an unpinned compiler makes the check mean different things on different machines. It was found the hard way, tsc 5.7 called this tree clean while 5.9.3 reported a real error in an untouched file. The scheduled jobs install with --omit=dev, so the compiler never ships to a runner: the bot itself runs under node --experimental-strip-types and never needs TypeScript at run time.
